title: Cover peers list JSON output in live tests
summary: Add an opt-in live CLI test that asserts `covenant peers list --json` returns a stable shape and that `truncated` behaves consistently with `--limit`.
expectedFailureModes: The JSON schema drifts without notice, breaking scripts that rely on it.
The CLI prints JSON to stdout but also emits human hints, producing invalid JSON.
`truncated` is incorrect when the daemon returns fewer rows than the limit but still had more peers available.
nextAction: Add live coverage for `--json` output and update the coverage matrix to point at the new test file.
